auth_type.correction: apiKey (optional; recommended). Unauthenticated access is allowed but rate-limited more tightly. Register at NCBI Account for an API key.

free_tier_limits.correction: No paid tier. Free public access: 3 requests/second without API key; 10 requests/second with API key. No formal request-volume free-tier cap beyond rate limits and NCBI usage policies (do not overload servers; use API keys for higher throughput).

rate_limits.correction: Without API key: ≤3 requests/second. With API key: ≤10 requests/second. NCBI may block IPs that exceed limits or abuse the service.

description.correction: NCBI E-utilities (Entrez Programming Utilities) is a set of server-side programs for programmatic access to the Entrez system and NCBI databases (PubMed, GenBank, Protein, etc.) via HTTP, returning XML, JSON, or other formats depending on the utility and parameters.

notes: Entry was essentially empty (empty base_url/docs_url/description/example/rate_limits). Automated curl HTTP 0 matches empty URLs. Auth is not strictly 'none'—optional api_key is the recommended modern practice. Formats include XML and others, not only JSON. CORS not documented officially.
